activities.name: To Temper Thyself and Journey Far
activities.description: Sixth edition of the Battle Pass growth system, containing character development materials, rewards, and a self-selected 5-star constellation gift.

activities.name: Archon Quest "Hour of Ruin" Limited-Time Rewards
activities.description: Complete the Archon Quest within the time limit to obtain Primogems x560, character enhancement materials, and more.

activities.name: "Where Kristall Roots Run Deep" Area Exploration Limited-Time Rewards
activities.description: After the version update, new Snezhnaya areas will be unlocked. Complete exploration quests within the time limit for an additional reward of Primogems x400.

activities.name: The Grand Defense: Defy the Unjust Judgment
activities.description: Join the relief efforts to reduce the Withering threat, choose to invite a 4-star character, and earn Primogems, Crowns of Insight, and more.

activities.name: Repertoire of Myriad Melodies Update - Encounter: Interlude of the Long Journey
activities.description: A new album "A Meeting on a Long Journey" is available in the music event. Complete the performance quests within the time limit to earn additional Primogems.

activities.name: Perilous Realm Trials
activities.description: Form three teams to face powerful foes. Complete challenges of different difficulties to earn Primogems, Sanctifying Elixir, and more.
